en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide, mostly empty plaza or square bordered by multi‑story European‑style buildings with balconies. On the left side are several horse‑drawn covered wagons and carts lined along the street. In the foreground to the right is a low, arcaded structure with several large round arches; people are sitting or resting in the shade beneath the arches. Above the arcade stands a modest two‑story building with a palm tree behind it. The setting looks historical, likely late 19th or early 20th century.
